cmd.welcome: Maid Cafe: Open the getting-started guide
description: Pick a colour, mark code ranges, and ask AI (aruaru-llm + aruaru-search, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Claude). Job import, learn-while-you-build flow, maid-cafe English and third-language translation.
wt.color.title: Mark code with a colour
wt.color.desc: Select code, right-click and choose "Maid Cafe: Mark selection with a colour" (Ctrl+Alt+M). Ranges with the same colour are asked about together.
wt.ask.title: Ask the AI, then follow up
wt.ask.desc: Ask about the selection (Ctrl+Alt+Q) or use Explain / Fix / Write tests. Fix shows a diff and applies only after you approve. Keys and tokens are masked before sending.
wt.provider.title: Choose your AI
wt.provider.desc: Free: aruaru-llm. Paid (ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Claude): you contract with the provider yourself and set your own API key; it is kept in VS Code secret storage. We handle no billing.
wt.project.title: Import a job and learn while you build
wt.project.desc: Import a job or project (URL, text, md/txt/docx/pdf), then step through requirements, design, tasks, code, review and debugging. Learning mode explains why at each step. Personal data is masked before sending.
wt.english.title: Maid-cafe English and a third language
wt.english.desc: Practice English with a maid; mistakes are corrected gently. Pick a third language so answers and replies also appear in it.
wt.title: Get started with Maid Cafe Code Helper
wt.desc: Colour, ask, import a job, practise English.

cmd.survey: Maid Cafe: Programmer survey (languages, frameworks and your level)
